title: Fame and Ultrafame: Measuring and comparing daily levels of ‘being talked about' for United States' presidents, their rivals, God, countries, and K-pop
reasoning: The paper uses the word "god" as a stable linguistic anchor to define a threshold for "lexical ultrafame" based on Twitter mentions. It is not evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics themselves, but rather leveraging the consistent high rank of the word "god" in Twitter discourse for methodological purposes related to its study of lexical fame.
